remarks: Welcome to Sunrise Hill! This well-loved and beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse has been cared for by the same owner for 34 years.  One of the first things you'll appreciate is the easy access, with just a few steps to the front door-something that sets this unit apart from many others in the complex. Inside, the main level offers a comfortable, inviting layout with plenty of natural light and a nice flow for everyday living.  Upstairs are two generously sized bedrooms with ample closet space and a full hall bath.  The finished lower level adds great flexibility, with two additional rooms that could work as a home office, den, exercise space or guest area, along with a half bath and laundry. Sliding doors lead directly to the private, fenced-in backyard-a wonderful extension of the living space for relaxing, gardening or entertaining.  Sunrise Hill offers a pool, tennis and pickleball courts and two playgrounds, all in a convenient, commuter-friendly location close to shopping, schools, transportation and everyday amenities.  Lovingly maintained for more than three decades, this is a home that's ready for its next owner to make it their own.
